use_cases.title: Smart Transportation & Traffic Connectivity
use_cases.desc: Links traffic management systems, road sensors, signal controllers, and monitoring devices over a unified communication network. This facilitates real-time traffic data exchange, coordinated signal operations, and more efficient management of urban transportation infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Mission-Critical Remote Site Networking
use_cases.desc: Provides dependable network connectivity for remote sites where continuous communication is essential for operations and safety. With resilient connectivity and remote management capabilities, it helps keep critical systems accessible while reducing the need for on-site support.

use_cases.title: High-Availability Outdoor Wi-Fi Coverage
use_cases.desc: Delivers consistent outdoor wireless coverage across large areas such as campuses, industrial sites, and public spaces. Designed for reliable connectivity in demanding environments, it keeps users and connected devices online with minimal service interruptions.
